C1 Tourism.name: C1 Tourism
C1 Tourism.description_en: Tourist visa, single entry, valid 60 days. Cannot be used for work or business activities.

C2 Business.name: C2 Business
C2 Business.description_en: Business visa, single entry, valid 60 days. Suited to business meetings, negotiations and non-employment activities.

C7A&B Music/Art.name: C7A&B Music/Art
C7A&B Music/Art.description_en: Single-entry visa for performing artists, musicians and cultural workers visiting Indonesia for short-term events.

C18 Work Trial.name: C18 Work Trial
C18 Work Trial.description_en: Single-entry visa for a 90-day work trial or skill assessment with an Indonesian employer prior to a full work permit.

C22A&B Internship (60 Days).name: C22A&B Internship (60 Days)
C22A&B Internship (60 Days).description_en: Single-entry internship visa for foreign trainees, valid 60 days, sponsored by an Indonesian host organisation.

C22A&B Internship (180 Days).name: C22A&B Internship (180 Days)
C22A&B Internship (180 Days).description_en: Single-entry internship visa for foreign trainees, valid 180 days, sponsored by an Indonesian host organisation.

C1 Tourism Extension.name: C1 Tourism Extension
C1 Tourism Extension.notes: Extension of C1 Tourism visa, +30 days
C1 Tourism Extension.description_en: Onshore extension of the C1 Tourism visa for an additional 30 days, processed at Indonesian immigration.

D1 Tourism (1 Year).name: D1 Tourism (1 Year)
D1 Tourism (1 Year).description_en: Multiple-entry tourist visa valid 1 year, allowing repeated visits with a maximum stay per entry as set by immigration.

D1 Tourism (2 Years).name: D1 Tourism (2 Years)
D1 Tourism (2 Years).description_en: Multiple-entry tourist visa valid 2 years, allowing repeated visits with a maximum stay per entry as set by immigration.

D1 Tourism (5 Years).name: D1 Tourism (5 Years)
D1 Tourism (5 Years).description_en: Multiple-entry tourist visa valid 5 years, allowing repeated visits with a maximum stay per entry as set by immigration.

D12 Business Investigation (1 Year).name: D12 Business Investigation (1 Year)
D12 Business Investigation (1 Year).description_en: Multiple-entry business investigation visa valid 1 year, for investors and business representatives exploring opportunities in Indonesia.

D12 Business Investigation (2 Years).name: D12 Business Investigation (2 Years)
D12 Business Investigation (2 Years).description_en: Multiple-entry business investigation visa valid 2 years, for investors and business representatives exploring opportunities in Indonesia.

Working KITAS (Altus/Onshore).name: Working KITAS (Altus/Onshore)
Working KITAS (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Standard work permit KITAS sponsored by an Indonesian employer. Onshore process via Altus, suited to candidates already in Indonesia.

Working KITAS (Offshore).name: Working KITAS (Offshore)
Working KITAS (Offshore).description_en: Standard work permit KITAS sponsored by an Indonesian employer. Offshore process for candidates outside Indonesia at time of application.

Working KITAS (Extend).name: Working KITAS (Extend)
Working KITAS (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing Working KITAS sponsored by an Indonesian employer.

Investor KITAS 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).name: Investor KITAS 2 Years (Altus/Onshore)
Investor KITAS 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Investor KITAS valid 2 years for shareholders of a PT PMA. Onshore process via Altus.

Investor KITAS 2 Years (Offshore).name: Investor KITAS 2 Years (Offshore)
Investor KITAS 2 Years (Offshore).description_en: Investor KITAS valid 2 years for shareholders of a PT PMA. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Investor KITAS 2 Years (Extend).name: Investor KITAS 2 Years (Extend)
Investor KITAS 2 Years (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing 2-year Investor KITAS for shareholders of a PT PMA.

Freelance E23 (Altus/Onshore).name: Freelance E23 (Altus/Onshore)
Freelance E23 (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Freelance E23 KITAS valid 6 months, sponsored work permit for independent professionals. Onshore process via Altus.

Freelance E23 (Offshore).name: Freelance E23 (Offshore)
Freelance E23 (Offshore).description_en: Freelance E23 KITAS valid 6 months, sponsored work permit for independent professionals. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

E33G Remote Worker (Altus/Onshore).name: E33G Remote Worker (Altus/Onshore)
E33G Remote Worker (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Digital nomad KITAS for remote workers employed by foreign companies. Onshore process via Altus, valid 1 year.

E33G Remote Worker (Offshore).name: E33G Remote Worker (Offshore)
E33G Remote Worker (Offshore).description_en: Digital nomad KITAS for remote workers employed by foreign companies. Processed from outside Indonesia, valid 1 year.

E33G Remote Worker (Extend).name: E33G Remote Worker (Extend)
E33G Remote Worker (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing E33G Remote Worker KITAS.

Spouse 1 Year (Altus/Onshore).name: Spouse 1 Year (Altus/Onshore)
Spouse 1 Year (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Spouse KITAS valid 1 year for foreign spouses of Indonesian citizens or KITAS/KITAP holders. Onshore process via Altus.

Spouse 1 Year (Offshore).name: Spouse 1 Year (Offshore)
Spouse 1 Year (Offshore).description_en: Spouse KITAS valid 1 year for foreign spouses of Indonesian citizens or KITAS/KITAP holders. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Spouse 1 Year (Extend).name: Spouse 1 Year (Extend)
Spouse 1 Year (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing 1-year Spouse KITAS.

Spouse 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).name: Spouse 2 Years (Altus/Onshore)
Spouse 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Spouse KITAS valid 2 years for foreign spouses of Indonesian citizens or KITAS/KITAP holders. Onshore process via Altus.

Spouse 2 Years (Offshore).name: Spouse 2 Years (Offshore)
Spouse 2 Years (Offshore).description_en: Spouse KITAS valid 2 years for foreign spouses of Indonesian citizens or KITAS/KITAP holders. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Spouse 2 Years (Extend).name: Spouse 2 Years (Extend)
Spouse 2 Years (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing 2-year Spouse KITAS.

Dependent 1 Year (Altus/Onshore).name: Dependent 1 Year (Altus/Onshore)
Dependent 1 Year (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Dependent KITAS valid 1 year for children or dependent family members of a primary KITAS/KITAP holder. Onshore process via Altus.

Dependent 1 Year (Offshore).name: Dependent 1 Year (Offshore)
Dependent 1 Year (Offshore).description_en: Dependent KITAS valid 1 year for children or dependent family members of a primary KITAS/KITAP holder. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Dependent 1 Year (Extend).name: Dependent 1 Year (Extend)
Dependent 1 Year (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing 1-year Dependent KITAS.

Dependent 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).name: Dependent 2 Years (Altus/Onshore)
Dependent 2 Years (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Dependent KITAS valid 2 years for children or dependent family members of a primary KITAS/KITAP holder. Onshore process via Altus.

Dependent 2 Years (Offshore).name: Dependent 2 Years (Offshore)
Dependent 2 Years (Offshore).description_en: Dependent KITAS valid 2 years for children or dependent family members of a primary KITAS/KITAP holder. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Dependent 2 Years (Extend).name: Dependent 2 Years (Extend)
Dependent 2 Years (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing 2-year Dependent KITAS.

Retirement (Altus/Onshore).name: Retirement (Altus/Onshore)
Retirement (Altus/Onshore).description_en: Retirement KITAS for foreign nationals 60+ meeting income requirements. Onshore process via Altus.

Retirement (Offshore).name: Retirement (Offshore)
Retirement (Offshore).description_en: Retirement KITAS for foreign nationals 60+ meeting income requirements. Offshore process for applicants outside Indonesia.

Retirement (Extend).name: Retirement (Extend)
Retirement (Extend).description_en: Onshore extension of an existing Retirement KITAS.

Investor KITAP + MERP.name: Investor KITAP + MERP
Investor KITAP + MERP.description_en: Permanent residence permit (KITAP) for investors holding shares in a PT PMA, bundled with Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit (MERP).

Dependent KITAP + MERP.name: Dependent KITAP + MERP
Dependent KITAP + MERP.description_en: Permanent residence permit (KITAP) for dependent family members of a primary KITAP holder, bundled with Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit (MERP).

Retirement KITAP + MERP.name: Retirement KITAP + MERP
Retirement KITAP + MERP.description_en: Permanent residence permit (KITAP) for retirees who have already held a Retirement KITAS, bundled with Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit (MERP).

MERP 1 Year.name: MERP 1 Year
MERP 1 Year.description_en: Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit valid 1 year for KITAP holders, allowing repeated travel without losing residence status.

MERP 2 Year.name: MERP 2 Year
MERP 2 Year.description_en: Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit valid 2 years for KITAP holders, allowing repeated travel without losing residence status.

Tier 0-50.name: Monthly Tax Report — 0 to 50 transactions (without LKPM & Annual)
Tier 0-50.notes: Bank + Cash transactions combined. LKPM and Annual Tax NOT included.
Tier 0-50.description_en: Monthly bookkeeping and tax filing for companies with low transaction volume. See section VI.4 for LKPM and Annual Tax stand-alone fees.

Tier 50-100.name: Monthly Tax Report — 50 to 100 transactions (without LKPM & Annual)
Tier 50-100.notes: Bank + Cash transactions combined. LKPM and Annual Tax NOT included.
Tier 50-100.description_en: Monthly bookkeeping and tax filing for companies with moderate transaction volume. See section VI.4 for LKPM and Annual Tax stand-alone fees.

Tier 100-200.name: Monthly Tax Report — 100 to 200 transactions (without LKPM & Annual)
Tier 100-200.notes: Bank + Cash transactions combined. LKPM and Annual Tax NOT included.
Tier 100-200.description_en: Monthly bookkeeping and tax filing for companies with higher transaction volume. See section VI.4 for LKPM and Annual Tax stand-alone fees.

Tier 200+.name: Monthly Tax Report — more than 200 transactions (without LKPM & Annual)
Tier 200+.notes: Bank + Cash transactions combined. LKPM and Annual Tax NOT included.
Tier 200+.description_en: Monthly bookkeeping and tax filing for companies with high transaction volume. See section VI.4 for LKPM and Annual Tax stand-alone fees.

Tier 0-50.name: Monthly Tax Report — 0 to 50 transactions (incl. LKPM & Annual)
Tier 0-50.notes: Includes LKPM monthly contribution and Annual Tax report.
Tier 0-50.description_en: Bundled monthly bookkeeping, LKPM filing and Annual Tax report for companies with low transaction volume.

Tier 50-100.name: Monthly Tax Report — 50 to 100 transactions (incl. LKPM & Annual)
Tier 50-100.notes: Includes LKPM monthly contribution and Annual Tax report.
Tier 50-100.description_en: Bundled monthly bookkeeping, LKPM filing and Annual Tax report for companies with moderate transaction volume.

Tier 100-200.name: Monthly Tax Report — 100 to 200 transactions (incl. LKPM & Annual)
Tier 100-200.notes: Includes LKPM monthly contribution and Annual Tax report.
Tier 100-200.description_en: Bundled monthly bookkeeping, LKPM filing and Annual Tax report for companies with higher transaction volume.

Tier 200+.name: Monthly Tax Report — more than 200 transactions (incl. LKPM & Annual)
Tier 200+.notes: Includes LKPM monthly contribution and Annual Tax report. Companies with more than 200 transactions per year must use monthly bookkeeping.
Tier 200+.description_en: Bundled monthly bookkeeping, LKPM filing and Annual Tax report for companies with high transaction volume.

Package A.name: Annual Basic Package A
Package A.notes: Does not include Annual Personal Tax report. No discount applies.
Package A.description_en: Up to 100 transactions per year. Includes Income Tax calculation only and yearly Financial Report for Annual Tax submission.

Package B.name: Annual Basic Package B
Package B.notes: Does not include Annual Personal Tax report. No discount applies.
Package B.description_en: 100-200 transactions per year. Income Tax only + yearly Financial Report.

Package C.name: Annual Basic Package C
Package C.notes: Does not include Annual Personal Tax report. No discount applies.
Package C.description_en: Up to 100 transactions per year. Income Tax + PPH 21 OR PPH Sewa (choose one) + yearly Financial Report.

Package D.name: Annual Basic Package D
Package D.notes: Does not include Annual Personal Tax report. No discount applies.
Package D.description_en: 100-200 transactions per year. Income Tax + PPH 21 OR PPH Sewa (choose one) + yearly Financial Report.

Annual Company ZERO.name: Annual Company ZERO
Annual Company ZERO.description_en: Yearly Financial Report only — for dormant companies with no transactions.

LKPM Yearly Report.name: LKPM Yearly Report
LKPM Yearly Report.description_en: Stand-alone yearly LKPM (investment realisation) report submitted to BKPM, required for all PT PMA companies.

Annual Tax Company.name: Annual Tax Company
Annual Tax Company.description_en: Stand-alone Annual Corporate Tax report (SPT Tahunan PPh Badan) for Indonesian companies.

Annual Tax Personal.name: Annual Tax Personal
Annual Tax Personal.description_en: Stand-alone Annual Personal Tax report (SPT Tahunan PPh Orang Pribadi) for individual taxpayers.

Annual Tax Personal (additional).name: Annual Tax Personal (additional)
Annual Tax Personal (additional).notes: Each additional person beyond the first.
Annual Tax Personal (additional).description_en: Stand-alone Annual Personal Tax report for additional persons beyond the first taxpayer in the same engagement.

New Company (PT PMA).name: New Company (PT PMA)
New Company (PT PMA).description_en: Full incorporation of a new Indonesian foreign-owned limited company (PT PMA), including notarial deed, BKPM/OSS registration and tax ID issuance.

Virtual Office.name: Virtual Office
Virtual Office.notes: Only for clients without their own commercial premises.
Virtual Office.description_en: Virtual office address for company registration and correspondence, suited to clients without dedicated commercial premises.

Akta Perubahan (Revision Company).name: Akta Perubahan (Revision Company)
Akta Perubahan (Revision Company).notes: Required when changing company address, directors, or business activities.
Akta Perubahan (Revision Company).description_en: Notarial amendment deed (Akta Perubahan) for an existing Indonesian company. Pricing depends on scope of changes.

Close PMA Company.name: Close PMA Company
Close PMA Company.description_en: Full closure and deregistration of an Indonesian foreign-owned limited company (PT PMA), including notarial deed, BKPM and tax authority deregistration.

NPWPD Registration.name: NPWPD Registration
NPWPD Registration.description_en: Local tax registration (Nomor Pokok Wajib Pajak Daerah) at the regency or city tax office, required per business location in Indonesia.

BPJS Employee (Tenaga Kerja).name: BPJS Employee (Tenaga Kerja)
BPJS Employee (Tenaga Kerja).description_en: Registration with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, the mandatory Indonesian social security scheme for employees covering accident, old-age and pension benefits.

BPJS Insurance (Kesehatan).name: BPJS Insurance (Kesehatan)
BPJS Insurance (Kesehatan).description_en: Registration with BPJS Kesehatan, the mandatory Indonesian national health insurance scheme.

NPWP Personal + Coretax Activation.name: NPWP Personal + Coretax Activation
NPWP Personal + Coretax Activation.description_en: Personal Indonesian tax ID (NPWP) issuance with activation on the Coretax platform.

Update Data / Coretax Activation.name: Update Data / Coretax Activation
Update Data / Coretax Activation.description_en: Update of taxpayer data (email, phone number, etc.) or stand-alone Coretax activation for an existing NPWP.

EFIN Application.name: EFIN Application
EFIN Application.description_en: Application for Electronic Filing Identification Number (EFIN) required to file taxes electronically with the Indonesian tax authority.

Reset Molina.name: Reset Molina
Reset Molina.description_en: Reset of immigration record on the Molina (immigration) database, often needed after data inconsistencies.

SKCK.name: SKCK
SKCK.description_en: Police clearance certificate (Surat Keterangan Catatan Kepolisian), often required for visa renewals and certain employment processes.

ACC Mutation Passport.name: ACC Mutation Passport
ACC Mutation Passport.description_en: Approval (ACC) for mutation of passport data on existing immigration permits.

Mutation Passport.name: Mutation Passport
Mutation Passport.description_en: Update of passport details on existing immigration permits after a passport renewal.

ACC Mutation.name: ACC Mutation
ACC Mutation.description_en: Approval (ACC) for mutation requests on existing immigration permits.

Mutation Address.name: Mutation Address
Mutation Address.description_en: Update of registered address on existing immigration permits.

Born Report.name: Born Report
Born Report.description_en: Birth report registration for foreign citizens born in Indonesia, required for subsequent dependent permits.

Electronic Passport 5 Years.name: Electronic Passport 5 Years
Electronic Passport 5 Years.description_en: Indonesian electronic passport (e-passport) issuance for 5-year validity.

Electronic Passport 10 Years.name: Electronic Passport 10 Years
Electronic Passport 10 Years.description_en: Indonesian electronic passport (e-passport) issuance for 10-year validity.

Passport 5 Years.name: Passport 5 Years
Passport 5 Years.description_en: Indonesian standard passport issuance for 5-year validity.

Passport 10 Years.name: Passport 10 Years
Passport 10 Years.description_en: Indonesian standard passport issuance for 10-year validity.

Domicilie Letter.name: Domicilie Letter
Domicilie Letter.description_en: Domicile letter (Surat Keterangan Domisili) issued by the local authority confirming the residential address.

Domicilie + SKTT.name: Domicilie + SKTT
Domicilie + SKTT.description_en: Bundle of domicile letter (Surat Keterangan Domisili) and temporary residence certificate (SKTT) for KITAS holders.

SKTT.name: SKTT
SKTT.description_en: Temporary residence certificate (Surat Keterangan Tempat Tinggal) issued by the local civil registration office, required for KITAS holders.

Cancel RPTKA.name: Cancel RPTKA
Cancel RPTKA.description_en: Cancellation of an existing RPTKA (foreign worker utilisation plan) at the Ministry of Manpower.

Cancel Wajib Lapor.name: Cancel Wajib Lapor
Cancel Wajib Lapor.description_en: Cancellation of mandatory employer reporting (Wajib Lapor Ketenagakerjaan) at the Ministry of Manpower.

Cancel (RPTKA, IMTA, Wajib Lapor).name: Cancel (RPTKA, IMTA, Wajib Lapor)
Cancel (RPTKA, IMTA, Wajib Lapor).description_en: Combined cancellation of RPTKA, IMTA and Wajib Lapor records at the Ministry of Manpower.

ACC Boarding Pass.name: ACC Boarding Pass
ACC Boarding Pass.description_en: Approval (ACC) for boarding pass issuance in scenarios requiring immigration verification before departure.

EPO (Exit Permit Only).name: EPO (Exit Permit Only)
EPO (Exit Permit Only).description_en: Exit Permit Only (EPO) for KITAS or KITAP holders permanently leaving Indonesia and surrendering their stay permit.

ERP (Exit Re-entry Permit).name: ERP (Exit Re-entry Permit)
ERP (Exit Re-entry Permit).description_en: Single-use Exit Re-entry Permit (ERP) for KITAS holders travelling abroad and returning before permit expiry.

Urgent 1 Hari.name: Urgent 1 Hari
Urgent 1 Hari.description_en: Urgent processing surcharge for 1-day turnaround on eligible immigration services.

Urgent 2 Hari.name: Urgent 2 Hari
Urgent 2 Hari.description_en: Urgent processing surcharge for 2-day turnaround on eligible immigration services.

Urgent 3 Hari.name: Urgent 3 Hari
Urgent 3 Hari.description_en: Urgent processing surcharge for 3-day turnaround on eligible immigration services.
